data.plain_english: You asked about Nvidia, but the council had no company-specific information, only how markets and industries have moved. Hong Kong shares fell sharply recently, and the council expects most Hong Kong industries and US banks and property firms to stay under pressure, partly because borrowing costs in the US have climbed to very high levels. US technology shares have actually risen lately, but the council is unsure whether that can last with rates this high. The biggest disagreement is over Hong Kong technology shares: some members see them as beaten down and due to recover, others see more trouble. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell anything.
